setup: Structural Mg alloys need higher strength, but the strong plastic anisotropy of hcp Mg leaves the soft orientations yielding at a few MPa

steps.effect_text: The dense basal planar defects are LPSO nanoplates: aggregates of four-layer Zn/Y-segregated fcc-type stacking faults, not conventional stacking faults
all_effect_text: The dense basal planar defects are LPSO nanoplates: aggregates of four-layer Zn/Y-segregated fcc-type stacking faults, not conventional stacking faults
steps.observation: Bright-field TEM taken with g=0002 shows strong planar fault-like contrast lying on (0001), roughly ten plates per um
observations: Bright-field TEM taken with g=0002 shows strong planar fault-like contrast lying on (0001), roughly ten plates per um
HAADF-STEM: the plates appear as bright, heavy-atom-rich bands only a few atomic layers wide; the 1 nm inset resolves one such bright band

Corresponding HAADF-STEM image. The inset shows a higher-magnification image. Zn/Y atoms are segregated along four atomic layers where an fcc-type stacking fault exists

steps.effect_text: Yield stress is strongly orientation dependent and, in [11-20] and [01-10], reaches ~145-165 MPa at RT, about 11x the pure-Mg single crystal
all_effect_text: Yield stress is strongly orientation dependent and, in [11-20] and [01-10], reaches ~145-165 MPa at RT, about 11x the pure-Mg single crystal
steps.observation: Yield stress in [11-20] at RT: 167 MPa as-grown, 113 MPa after the 520 C anneal, 160 MPa after the further 400 C anneal
observations: Yield stress in [11-20] at RT: 167 MPa as-grown, 113 MPa after the 520 C anneal, 160 MPa after the further 400 C anneal
RT yield stress by orientation: ~9 MPa for [1 1 -2 1.85], ~148-165 MPa for [11-20], ~143 MPa for [01-10]; [0001] fractures at ~355 MPa without yielding

Between RT and 400 C the alloy's [11-20]/[01-10] yield stress falls only from ~165 to ~105 MPa, while the gray pure-Mg reference falls from ~270 to ~15 MPa and sits near 10 MPa in the soft orientations

steps.effect_text: The crystal keeps a yield stress above 100 MPa with more than 5% compressive plastic strain in [11-20] and [01-10] from RT to 400 C
all_effect_text: The crystal keeps a yield stress above 100 MPa with more than 5% compressive plastic strain in [11-20] and [01-10] from RT to 400 C
In tension along [0001] the crystal elongates ~45% at 65-80 MPa by kink-band formation, the first bulk demonstration of tensile ductility by kinking
steps.observation: Tensile [0001] test at RT: the flow stress starts at ~72 MPa, is serrated between ~52 and ~80 MPa, and the specimen reaches ~45% plastic strain before fracture
observations: Tensile [0001] test at RT: the flow stress starts at ~72 MPa, is serrated between ~52 and ~80 MPa, and the specimen reaches ~45% plastic strain before fracture
The tensile gauge is filled with fine bands inclined to the [0001] tensile direction, across which the marked basal-plane trace kinks

Between RT and 400 C the alloy's [11-20]/[01-10] yield stress falls only from ~165 to ~105 MPa, while the gray pure-Mg reference falls from ~270 to ~15 MPa and sits near 10 MPa in the soft orientations

Stress-strain curves: [11-20], [01-10] and [1 1 -2 1.85] all pass 5% plastic strain at RT and 300 C, [0001] fractures without yielding (x at ~355 and ~255 MPa), and only [01-10] at RT work-hardens, 165 -> 205 MPa
